description.value: Indian Delicacy is an authentic Indian restaurant established in 2017 in the heart of downtown Vancouver, offering lounge-style dining for up to 60 guests alongside takeout and delivery. The menu spans regional Indian dishes including tandoor specialties, multiple biryani styles, Indo-Chinese fare, and a broad selection of vegetarian options. The restaurant also accommodates private gatherings and events.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 64m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms an active Indian restaurant at 1130 West Pender Street, downtown Vancouver, with explicit mentions of takeout/delivery and a menu with dedicated vegetarian sections (Veg Appetizers, Veg Main Course, Veg Dum Biryanis). No bike parking, water refill, washroom, Wi-Fi, or cycling-specific amenity information appears anywhere in the website or OSM tags. The /about.html page title erroneously references 'Luxury Hotel' and 'Lowest Price Hotels Downtown,' which appears to be an SEO copy-paste error unrelated to the actual business.
concerns: OSM record contains no street address; address '1130 West Pender Street, Vancouver, BC' sourced from website contact page.
OSM record contains no phone number; phone '604-569-2122' sourced from website contact page.
The /about.html page title reads 'Luxury Hotel in Vancouver Canada|Lowest Price Hotels Downtown' — appears to be an SEO template copy-paste error; the business is a restaurant, not a hotel.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate full-service Indian restaurant in downtown Vancouver with dine-in, takeout, and delivery; a useful food stop for touring cyclists passing through the city centre.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes dedicated Veg Appetizers, Veg Main Course, and Veg Dum Biryanis sections with multiple dishes each
